title: Nemotron-Cascade 2: Post-Training LLMs with Cascade RL and Multi-Domain On-Policy Distillation

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: What if we could build AI that truly reasons and acts — but at what cost to society and ethics?

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: Nemotron-Cascade 2 uses cascade RL and multi-domain distillation to enable strong agentic reasoning with 3B activated parameters.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: But if such models become too powerful, who controls their use? Could they be weaponized or used for mass manipulation?

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: Builders are embedding guardrails, using alignment techniques, and open-sourcing with clear usage guidelines to mitigate misuse.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: Imagine a future where AI agents help solve climate crises and manage global health — if we get alignment right.

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: The future of AI depends on balancing innovation with responsibility — a dance between progress and ethics.
